summary: Tested the new 30-minute auto-close/auto-save feature in take-attendance.tsx live in the browser (390x844 viewport, X-Platform: mobile header, teacher180156), with test lectures inserted into Mongo at controlled deadlines. I ran the whole countdown to zero live several times. WORKING: the red banner shows only when under 2 minutes remain; the mm:ss countdown goes down every second and matches the deadline; 'حفظ الآن' opens the lesson modal, saves the current toggles correctly (DB showed 1 absent + lesson_title) and goes back; auto-save fires about 5s before the deadline (saved 17:31:55 for a 17:32:00 deadline) with the message '⏰ انتهت مهلة الـ30 دقيقة — تم حفظ الحضور تلقائياً وإغلاق الشاشة' and then goes back; no banner when the deadline is far away or attendance is already recorded; manual save still works and keeps the toggles (2 absent persisted); tapping a row still toggles it while the banner is shown. BROKEN: (1) the auto-save IGNORES the teacher's toggles and saves the state from when the screen loaded. I toggled 2 students to absent and Mongo had all 72 present. (2) Opening a lecture whose window has ALREADY expired immediately sends POST /api/attendance/session with records=[] and pops the server's 400 alert 'انتهى وقت فتح التحضير'. This repeats every time the screen is opened, including when the history back button returns to it. (3) If the server rejects the auto-save with 400/403, the code only shows an alert: it does not store locally and does not close the screen. (4) When the server is unreachable but the device still reports online, only 1 of 72 records was kept in the local pending queue (offline_pending_records). The cause is a race in the existing offlineSyncStore code.

ui_bugs.issue: Stale closure: setInterval's tick calls the saveAttendance captured when the effect last ran. `attendance` (also lessonTitle, planTopicId, isOnline, offlineMode, students) is not in the deps, so student toggles after load are NOT included in the auto-save. Reproduced: toggled 12345 and 12346 to غائب while the banner was showing; after auto-save, Mongo had 72/72 present.

fetchData sets lecture/students and then does `await cacheLecture(...)` BEFORE setAttendanceStatus/setAttendance. That causes a render with attendanceStatus=null and attendance={}. The timer effect passes its guards, diff<=5000 (deadline already past), and saveAttendance({auto:true}) fires right away with records=[]. Seen in the browser: 'POST session lecture=<expired> n_records=0', a 400 response, and the alert 'انتهى وقت فتح التحضير (الحد الأقصى للتأخير 30 دقيقة)' on every open of an expired lecture. Data-loss risk: for users with edit permission (admin/dean/canEditAttendance) the backend skips the time check, so an empty/partial records payload could be saved for an unrecorded past lecture and mark it completed (by code reading; not run because it could change real data).

When isAuto and the server rejects with 400/403 (for example late because of clock skew or latency), the code only calls window.alert(serverError). It does NOT store the attendance locally, does NOT goBack, and does NOT show the 30-minute message. This breaks the requirement that a late rejection should still store locally, show a clear message and close. The screen stays open with the banner hidden (remainingMs=0) and autoSaveTriggeredRef=true, so it is not retried.

Race: take-attendance awaits addAttendanceRecord in a loop. While isOnline=true, each call starts syncPendingRecords. The first sync takes a snapshot of pendingRecords, and at the end its set({pendingRecords: cleanedRecords}) overwrites the records added during the sync. Reproduced with /api/** aborted (server unreachable, device online): after the fallback message 'تم حفظ الحضور محلياً (فشل الاتصال بالخادم)' only 1 of 72 records was left in localStorage offline_pending_records, and the toggled absent student was missing.

integration_issues.issue: The auto-save fallback path (network error) shows the generic 'تم حفظ الحضور محلياً (فشل الاتصال بالخادم)' instead of a message about the 30-minute deadline.

issues: The banner renders above the lesson modal's overlay and is still visible and tappable while the modal is open (minor). Otherwise contrast, layout and RTL look fine.

action_items: Fix the stale closure: keep a ref to the latest saveAttendance (const saveRef = useRef(saveAttendance); saveRef.current = saveAttendance; on every render) and call saveRef.current({auto:true}) inside tick. Or keep attendance/lessonTitle/isOnline/offlineMode in refs.

Do not run the auto-save timer until the lecture data has fully loaded (attendanceStatus !== null and attendance has entries). Also skip it when the deadline was already past at mount (diff <= buffer on the first tick) or when Object.keys(attendance).length === 0. Alternatively move setAttendanceStatus/setAttendance before `await cacheLecture`.
In the saveAttendance catch block, when isAuto and the status is 400/403: store the records offline (addAttendanceRecord), show an auto-specific message, and goBack().

Fix the offlineSyncStore race: in syncPendingRecords, merge the results back into get().pendingRecords by local_id instead of overwriting with the snapshot. Or add all records in one batch and sync once after the loop.
Optional: max_delay is set per faculty (faculty.max_attendance_delay_minutes) but the frontend hardcodes 30. Use attendanceStatus.deadline or the server's minutes_remaining to stay consistent.
critical_code_review_comments: take-attendance.tsx is 1357 lines; it should be split (for example a useAttendanceAutoClose hook plus a banner component).
The auto-save effect deps include `saving`, so the interval is torn down and recreated on every save. Harmless, but it shows the closure design is fragile.
The offline save loop is duplicated in the offline branch and the catch fallback (>10 lines, DRY violation) and could be extracted.
The modal 'تخطّي' path calls setLessonTitle('') and then saveAttendance(), which still reads the old lessonTitle (pre-existing stale state).
updated_files: /app/tests/autoclose_setup.py (new test helper only; no app code changed)

success_rate.frontend: 62% (5/8 scenarios pass: banner+countdown, Save Now, far-deadline no banner, recorded no banner, manual save/toggle regression; fail: auto-save uses current toggles, no conflicting behaviour on expired lectures, late-rejection fallback)

seed_data_creation: Created 9 test lectures (created_by='autoclose_test_script') and their attendance docs. All were deleted by id at the end (9 lectures, 288 attendance docs). The backend may also have written side records (activity logs/notifications) for these lectures; those were not touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use /app/tests/autoclose_setup.py: `create <secs_to_deadline>` (rounds up to the next minute boundary), `inspect <id>`, `cleanup`. In Playwright, set the X-Platform: mobile header, click the 'تسجيل الدخول' text (Enter does not submit), and call subprocess for setup inside the script to save time. The full countdown to auto-save fits within one tool call when the deadline is about 45-90s away. Import asyncio for the dialog handler. To simulate server-unreachable, route-abort **/api/** after visiting the lecture once and then go_forward. context.set_offline does not work because the go_forward does a full page reload.
rca of the issue: Auto-save ignores toggles: the interval callback captures the saveAttendance closure from the render when the effect ran. Its deps omit `attendance`, so later toggles never reach that closure. Repro: open a lecture about 60s before its deadline, toggle a student to absent, wait. Mongo shows all present. Expired-lecture auto-POST: in fetchData, `await cacheLecture` between setStudents and setAttendanceStatus/setAttendance produces an intermediate render where the guards pass (status null) and the deadline is already past, so auto-save fires with an empty attendance map. Repro: open any unrecorded lecture whose start was more than 30 minutes ago. You get an immediate 400 alert, and backend logs show POST /api/attendance/session 400.
